FXC07.exactContractHeading: ## FXC-07 — Numeric and native resolution boundaries
FXC07.exactNamedRequirement: Exercise native attack/AC, Core tasks/natural shifts, opposed ties, binary saves and genuine before-consequence rerolls. Include independent percentage floors before saves/defenses, actual damage/Temp HP/overkill, typed distribution, per-die versus per-packet additions, current critical ranges, healing/Wounds/Critical ceilings, fixed strength/capacity branches, source-specific no-resource flags and finite reserve consumption. An authored example is not an executed runtime test.

areas.name: Native attacks, AC and natural attack results
areas.submittedMeaning: Native attack rules; a margin is not a critical. Expanded19 still needs an actual hit.
areas.reasoning: FR85-01-1 through -5 distinguish ordinary AC hits, natural 1/20, and natural 19 critical-if-hit. Weapon Mastery uses the broadest actual range; no +10 attack margin becomes a critical.

areas.name: Core tasks/natural shifts, opposed ties and binary saves
areas.submittedMeaning: Do not transfer task degrees/natural shifts into attacks or binary saves; initiator loses unchanged-state opposed ties.
areas.reasoning: FR85-02/03/04 preserve Core task degrees and natural shifts, binary saves, and opposed equal totals retaining the old state. These are distinct procedures, not one d20 rule reused by label.

areas.name: Genuine before-consequence rerolls
areas.submittedMeaning: Named die positions versus whole original save procedure, mandatory replacement and no rollback; current mental predicate is separately retained.
areas.reasoning: FR85-05 through -08 preserve named-die-position replacement versus a whole original save procedure, mandatory worse replacements, before-consequence timing and no rollback. Actual eligibility remains source-specific.

areas.name: Independent native percentage floors and typed distribution
areas.submittedMeaning: Independent floor from the same native eligible subtotal; independent external riders excluded; stable typed allocation and defenses follow.
areas.reasoning: FR85-09 through -12 retain independent floors on the same native eligible packet, proportional mixed-type largest-remainder allocation and exclusion of external riders. The native 19 example adds 9+9+3, not a multiplied percentage chain.

areas.name: Actual damage, temporary HP, overkill, Wounds and death order
areas.submittedMeaning: Actual lost normal HP plus absorbed temporary HP, not overkill or state assignment; instant death precedes remaining Wound processing.
areas.reasoning: FR85-13 through -18 retain temp absorption, actual normal HP loss, overkill exclusion, one overlapping Wound check, instant death precedence, Maiming scope and Stable-at-zero boundaries. Earlier state-assignment rules are not generalized into damage.

areas.name: Per-die versus per-packet additions
areas.submittedMeaning: Actual distinct die identities versus flat event/roll additions; rerolls do not create extra dice; no critical doubling of ordinary flats.
areas.reasoning: Current Evocation Focus and Elemental Adept distinguish actual die identities from rerolls/maximized or flat values. Berserker/Companion Training remain once-per-hit/roll flats; Durable and Quick Recovery remain per-die versus first-rest-installment additions. Full original semantic outcomes are inherited.

areas.name: Current critical ranges and eligible dice
areas.submittedMeaning: Broadest actual range rather than additive threshold steps; native20 and critical-if-hit remain distinct.
areas.reasoning: Weapon Mastery and Exploit Weakness compare actual critical ranges, preserving the natural-19 AC requirement and natural-20 rule. Piercer/Disarming Blow retain their exact eligible dice, pre-critical payment and rider scopes.

areas.name: Healing installments, Wounds, finite reserves and Critical ceilings
areas.submittedMeaning: First eligible installment, spent Hit Dice/rest epochs, blocked/direct recovery, finite source reserves and max(1,maxHP-1) Critical ceiling. Separate vectors do not simulate the combined nested dispatcher.
areas.reasoning: The full 56-case healing report supplies installments, blocked first use, actual rest epochs/Hit Dice, recipient-family kit/Surgeon uses, direct versus ordinary recovery, finite Life Drinker/Mutation reserves and Critical ceilings. The combined nested Healer/Field Medic/Field Surgeon dispatcher remains unexecuted and separately governed.

areas.name: Explicit Strength-fixed branches and real capacity
areas.submittedMeaning: New FN109-01 adds the exact attack-ability/Strength-fixed comparison. Actual carrying and resource capacity use existing body/class sources; growth does not refill.
areas.reasoning: FN109-01 supplies the explicit DEX attack +7 while native STR damage remains +1, attack-ability-dependent Disarming DC15 and STR-fixed Bull Rush/Shield Bash DC12. Genuine capacity growth examples retain current amounts without refilling; capacity slices do not independently grant higher-level feats.

areas.name: Source-specific no-resource flags, one paid refund and finite spending
areas.submittedMeaning: Preserve flags through descendants; numeric damage alone cannot erase source prohibitions. One actual payment cannot be refunded twice.
areas.reasoning: FR85-24 and its rejection boundaries share one actual paid2-RP expense across Recall/Resonance. Life Drinker and Bio-Stabilizer keep causal no-resource/excess-conversion restrictions and distinct finite reserves; numeric damage never erases those source flags.
